item.title: Striker Viktor Gyokeres Optimistic Arsenal Will End Title Drought In Premier League This Season
item.description: Striker Viktor Gyokeres: Arsenal won the English Premier League title way back in the 2003-04 season and have since come close to regaining the title, only to fall short. They have come close to winning the title in the last three seasons, finishing a close second to champions Liverpool in the 2024-25 season. However, the Gunners' Swedish striker Viktor Gyökeres believes their title drought will come to an end in this ongoing season.

item.title: Murphy, Richardson Named In Boxing Day Test Squad, Lyon To Undergo Surgery
item.description: Boxing Day Test: Todd Murphy and Jhye Richardson have been added to Australia's 15-member squad for the fourth Ashes Test, starting on December 26.

item.title: Pakistan Withdraws Players From US Junior Squash After Age Verification Not Accepted: Report
item.description: US Open Junior Squash Championship: Faced with doubts over the age of its players in an age-group event, Pakistan was forced to withdraw its players from the US Open Junior Squash Championship after the organisers refused to accept its age verification process, a news report said on Monday.

item.title: Cummins Ruled Out Of Remainder Of Ashes, T20 World Cup Participation Uncertain
item.description: T20 World Cup: Skipper Pat Cummins has been ruled out of the rest of the Ashes series after being left out of Australia’s squad for the Boxing Day Test, and it is unclear whether he will be available for the T20 World Cup in February.

item.title: Neres Inspires Napoli To Win Third Italian Super Cup Title
item.description: Italian Super Cup: David Neres scored twice as Napoli beat Bologna 2-0 to win the Italian Super Cup.

item.title: 'We Haven’t Done That Well Enough', Admits Rob Key On England’s Ashes Defeat
item.description: Boxing Day Test: Rob Key, England cricket team's managing director, has conceded that England’s current setup has fallen short when it has mattered most, pointing out that they have not won any of their last four five-Test series against Australia or India.

item.title: HIL: Soorma Hockey Club Retains Harmanpreet As Men's Skipper, Savita and Salima As Women's Co-captains
item.description: Marang Gomke Jaipal Singh Munda: Soorma Hockey Club (SHC) has announced that it will retain the same on-field leadership for its men’s and women’s teams in the upcoming editions of the Hockey India League.

item.title: Sharjah Warriorz survive low-scoring thriller to beat Abu Dhabi Knight Riders
item.description: Sharjah Warriorz held their nerve to clinch a dramatic four-wicket win over Abu Dhabi Knight Riders at the Zayed Cricket Stadium on Monday. They moved to six points, and with two games to spare, have set up a tight race for the remaining playoff spots in DP World ILT20 Season 4.

item.title: Formula 1 2025 Season Turns Out To Be Pivotal Year For Indian Motorsport
item.description: Red Bull Junior Team: Formula 1 has experienced a remarkable rise in popularity across the subcontinent, with India's fanbase expanding to 78.8 million. This significant growth coincides with a season marked by outstanding performances, including Kush Maini’s resilient win in Monaco and Arvid Lindblad’s rapid ascent to the F1 grid. item.title: Ashes: Rob Key To Investigate Allegations Of Players Having ‘a Drinking Stag-do’ Before Adelaide Test
item.description: Boxing Day Test: England cricket team's managing director Rob Key defended the team’s four-day trip to Noosa, taken between the second and third Ashes Tests, and stated that the board is investigating claims that their travel was turned into a beer-filled stag party.
